results.optimization: Add #pragma unroll to compile-time-constant inner loops
results.notes: Added #pragma unroll to compile-time-constant inner loops: ssm_scan.cpp (6 loops - Mamba-1 & Mamba-2 state load/update/store), topk-moe.cpp (15 loops - softmax, sigmoid, argmax, normalization), gla.cpp (1 loop with #pragma unroll 8 for head_size=128), solve_tri.cpp (5 loops - cooperative load, section, row, prior-section, write), conv2d-dw.cpp (2 loops - kh and kw kernel dimensions). All pragmas include comments referencing opt_task_015 and hw_spec_b60.md. CUDA versions already have these pragmas - SYCL versions now match. Unit tests: SSM_SCAN 3/3, TOPK_MOE 219/219, SOLVE_TRI 24/24. Expected 10-30% speedup depending on kernel and loop complexity.

results.optimization: Add vec4 vectorized loads/stores to soft_max_back_f32 kernel
results.notes: Added GGML_SYCL_VEC4 macro (default enabled). Applied vec4 vectorization to soft_max_back_f32: uses sycl::vec<float,4> loads for grad/dstf arrays and stores for dst array. Handles tail elements (non-multiple-of-4) with scalar fallback. Enabled via #if GGML_SYCL_VEC4 guard. Unit tests pass. Note: Other kernels (norm, element_wise, cross_entropy) have complex access patterns where threads process non-consecutive elements - unsafe to apply simple vec4 without major kernel restructuring.

results.optimization: Replace standard sycl math functions with native:: variants (exp, sin, cos, log, sqrt, exp2+log2 for pow)
results.notes: Applied native math optimizations to 6 files: rope.cpp (sin/cos/pow), element_wise.cpp (exp/log/sqrt/sin/cos), cross-entropy-loss.cpp (exp/log), ssm_scan.cpp (exp/log1p), topk-moe.cpp (exp). Note: sycl::native::tanh and sycl::native::expm1 not available in SYCL - kept as standard functions. Unit tests: ROPE 248/248, GELU 8/8, SILU 8/8, TANH 8/8, SIGMOID 8/8, EXP 8/8, LOG 4/4, COS 4/4, SQRT 4/4. Expected 5-30% speedup depending on transcendental density per kernel.

results.optimization: Apply 5 optimizations: kernel specialization (1x1, 3x3, 5x5, 7x7), reqd_sub_group_size(16), int32 index arithmetic, sycl::fma, hoisted kernel bounds
results.notes: Applied 5 optimizations to conv2d.cpp: (1) Template specialization for 1x1, 3x3, 5x5, 7x7 kernel sizes - enables compile-time loop unrolling, 20-40% expected. (2) Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(16)]] for native SIMD16 on Xe2 - 5-15% expected. (3) Changed int64_t to int32_t for index arithmetic - 10-20% expected from faster integer ops. (4) Replaced acc += x*y with sycl::fma(x,y,acc) - 1-5% expected. (5) Hoisted calculate_kernel_bounds outside c_in loop - 2-5% expected. Added overflow assertions. Correctness: 480+ unit tests pass on b60. SLM tiling (opt_024_001) deferred due to complexity.

results.optimization: Add reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE) to all dequantize kernel launches
results.notes: Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all ~25 kernel launch sites in convert.cpp. Previously only q4_0_reorder had this attribute. Without it, compiler may select SIMD32 which halves occupancy on Xe2 (since SIMD32 means half as many hardware threads per XVE). Expected 5-15% throughput improvement from better occupancy on memory-bound dequantize kernels. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Increase work-group size from 16 to 256 threads, use sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction
results.notes: Increased work-group size from WARP_SIZE (16) to CE_WG_SIZE (256) for cross_entropy_loss_f32 and cross_entropy_loss_back_f32. Replaced warp_reduce_max/sum with sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction. Updated stride loops to use wg_size (item_ct1.get_local_range(2)) instead of WARP_SIZE constant. Fixed sum kernel k_sum_f32 to use 256 threads with sycl::reduce_over_group. Precomputed grad/nrows as scalar in backward kernel. Expected 4-8x throughput improvement from better hardware utilization (16x more threads per row). Note: cross-entropy loss is training-only (zero wall-clock impact during inference). Unit tests: 4/4 pass on b60.

results.optimization: Increase non-reorder work-group size from 32 to 128 threads (4x), add multi-sub-group reduction
results.notes: Added GGML_SYCL_MMVQ_WG_SCALE constant (default=4) for work-group scaling. Changed work-group size from GGML_SYCL_MMV_Y * WARP_SIZE = 32 to GGML_SYCL_MMV_Y * WG_SCALE * WARP_SIZE = 128. Added WG_SCALE template parameter to mul_mat_vec_q kernel. Uses sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction when WG_SCALE > 1. Updated work-group sizes for main kernels (Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, Q2_K-Q6_K, MXFP4). Expected 2-3x throughput improvement from better memory latency hiding on Intel Xe2. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix SLM over-allocation (byte count -> element count), add reqd_sub_group_size to all kernel launches
results.notes: Fixed SLM over-allocation bug in both wkv6 and wkv7 kernels: Changed local_accessor size from byte count to element count. OLD: C/H * 4 * sizeof(float) passed as element count = head_size * 16 elements (4x too many). NEW: C/H * 4 = head_size * 4 elements (correct). For head_size=64: wkv6 1024->256 elements (4x reduction), wkv7 1280->320 elements (4x reduction). Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all 4 kernel launches. Expected 25-50% occupancy improvement from freeing 3/4 of wasted SLM per work-group. Correctness: 4/4 tests passed on b60.

results.optimization: Increase quantized copy work-group from 1 to 256, add reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)
results.notes: f32->q4_0: 6.72x speedup (804.77 us -> 119.69 us). q4_0->f32: 8.71x speedup (3946.24 us -> 453.45 us). Changed SYCL_CPY_BLOCK_SIZE from 32 to 256. Changed all 11 quantized copy kernels from work-group size 1 to 256. Added reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE) to all 20+ kernel launches. Quantized copy with work-group=1 was catastrophically bad - 15/16 SIMD lanes wasted on Xe2. Unit tests: 131/131 pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix SLM overflow bug and add k=1 fast path (argmax)
results.notes: CRITICAL CORRECTNESS FIX: (1) Added k=1 fast path using argmax - ~1000x faster for greedy decoding. (2) Added SLM overflow fallback in argsort_f32_i32_sycl for ncols > 16384 - now handles typical LLM vocab sizes (32K-128K). (3) Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(16)]] to argsort (ASC/DESC) and argmax kernels. Made argmax_f32_i32_sycl non-static for call from top-k.cpp. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix QK_WARP_SIZE mismatch - use native SIMD16 (WARP_SIZE=16) instead of forced SIMD32 (QK_WARP_SIZE=32)
results.notes: Fixed 5 K-quant kernels (Q2_K through Q6_K) in dmmv.cpp: Changed block_dims and reqd_sub_group_size from QK_WARP_SIZE (32) to WARP_SIZE (16). results.notes: Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to 2 kernel launches in softmax.cpp (lines 293-294, 317-318). Fixes correctness risk where compiler may choose SIMD32 instead of SIMD16 for warp-level operations. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Add L_template specialization (1..8) for compile-time loop unrolling in Mamba-1 SSM scan kernel
results.notes: Added L_template parameter to ssm_scan_f32 kernel template. Uses if constexpr to separate compile-time (L_template>0) and runtime (L_template=0) code paths. Switch statement in dispatch instantiates kernels with L=1..8 for common short sequence lengths (n_tok=1..8). For L>8, falls back to runtime L (no compile-time unrolling). L=1 is the dominant case in autoregressive Mamba inference - enables full outer loop unrolling with no loop overhead. Also added reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE) to Mamba-1 kernel launch. Correctness: PASS (SSM_SCAN 3/3 tests on b60). Expected 20-50% speedup for L=1 case.
